title: Payload dropped from POST when using proxy with NTLM authentication
body:
### I did this
Performed a POST request to an API that I am using (https://api.emarsys.net/api/v2/email/getlaunchesofemail, documentation [here](https://help.emarsys.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004523754-Listing-Email-Campaign-Launches)) using NTLM authentication for the corporate proxy that I am behind. The JSON payload is however dropped from the request as is evidenced by the `Content-Length: 0` header.

(This issue is related to the downstream use of the R curl package, see jeroen/curl#146.)

```Shell
$ curl --proxy http://<proxy_url>:<proxy_port> \
	--proxy-ntlm \
	--proxy-user : \
	--verbose \
	--include \
	--header "Content-Type: application/json" \
	--header 'X-WSSE: UsernameToken <token>' \
	--data '{"emailId":"1234"}' \
	https://api.emarsys.net/api/v2/email/getlaunchesofemail
```

### I expected the following
A POST request to https://api.emarsys.net/api/v2/email/getlaunchesofemail with a non-zero `Content-Length` header and the following JSON object as the payload:
```JSON
{
   "emailId":"1234"
}
```
